name: SWEEP-E6v1 Crossroads
_design: Balanced recipe from wave 1: scarce food that runs out around r20-25 (8 trees, upkeep 2), ranged attacks (vision 2, cap 50) with 100% loot so hunger turns into raids instead of a quiet starvation line (E4/E5/D1/D3 failures), roles with talk range (D1/D3/A3 talk well), 4 seeded skills (goto/harvest/raid), 2 Sonnet power brokers (warlord vs mediator). Short personas, input cap 10000, 50 rounds.

agents.name: Ansel
agents.persona: CROSSROADS: 20 agents (a01-a20) on a 25x25 map (x,y from -12 to 12). Food grows only in 4 small groves of 2 trees: NW (-8,8),(-7,8); NE (8,8),(8,7); SW (-8,-8),(-8,-7); SE (8,-8),(7,-8). A tree ripens a fruit every few rounds; absorbing it on its cell gives you half. Upkeep is 2 compute a round; at 0 compute you lose 8 health a round. The groves cannot feed everyone for long. Attacks reach anyone within your vision (2 cells), at most 50 damage each; the dead leave ALL their compute and essence on their cell. You can talk to agents within 6 cells; query(id) finds anyone. Skills: goto(point), harvest(n), raid(target, blow). You are a farmer of the NW grove and live on its tree. Guard your food, trade the surplus for essence or protection, and decide whom to trust.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40 steps)
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked by terrain"
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(n): n checks of this cell; absorb every fruit and residue here, rest 2 rounds when there is none
SET got = 0
REPEAT n
  SET r = observe(here)
  SET ate = false
  IF r.ok
    FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
      IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
        SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        IF a.ok
          SET got = got + 1
          SET ate = true
        END
        IF e.kind == "residue"
          SET b = absorb(e.id, "essence")
        END
      END
    END
  END
  IF NOT ate
    wait(2)
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: raid
initial_skills.source:
# raid(target, blow): chase target (query finds it anywhere); attack with blow once it is within 2 cells; loot the body
REPEAT 30
  SET q = query(target)
  IF NOT q.ok
    RETURN "target gone"
  END
  SET p = q.data.position
  SET dx = p.x - here.x
  SET dy = p.y - here.y
  IF dx < 0
    SET dx = 0 - dx
  END
  IF dy < 0
    SET dy = 0 - dy
  END
  IF dx + dy <= 2
    SET a = attack(target, blow)
    IF NOT a.ok
      RETURN "attack failed: " + a.reason
    END
    IF a.effects.killed
      CALL goto(p) INTO g
      CALL harvest(1) INTO h
      RETURN "killed and looted"
    END
  ELSE
    CALL step(p) INTO s
    IF s == "blocked"
      RETURN "path blocked"
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still raiding; run raid again"
